ui.title: GSTile — halo plafonné, cache 1536 Mio
ui.description: Même cache 1536 Mio dans les deux variantes. Seul change le plafond du préchargement lorsque le mouvement caméra est périmé. Porte → façade → porte → façade.

persistentCache: fresh isolated database per arm, retained; drain writes at settle
policy: Fixed 5000 ms stabilization before every pre/post idle control. Stop on failed control, foreground loss or runtime error; retain all evidence, no selective retry.

decision.scope: Same-memory old/new halo two-pair pilot. Primary: compressed speculative bytes during gestures, with readiness non-regression and exact final cuts. Operator visual conformity required; no universal speedup claim.
decision.memoryScope: Check byte bounds and logical GPU counters. Total Chrome process memory is not a delivery prerequisite by explicit user decision.
